enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Yawn. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up soap. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Remove pajamas. Put on clothes.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Scoop cereal. Lift spoon to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Drink milk from bowl. Put spoon in bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing lunch and getting ready to leave
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out cheese. Close refrigerator. Take out knife. Take out cutting board. Place bread on cutting board. Place cheese on bread. Cut sandwich. Take out lunch bag. Place sandwich in lunch bag. Put lunch bag in backpack. Put on shoes. Put on jacket. Pick up keys. Pick up phone. Walk to door. Open door. Walk out. Close door.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Release parking brake. Press gas pedal. Drive. Stop at red light. Press gas pedal. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Walk to building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Turn on computer. Log in. Open patient schedule. Review patient charts. Pick up phone. Call patient. Walk to waiting room. Say 'Mrs. Smith, please follow me.' Walk to exam room. Close door. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Measure blood pressure. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Type notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Take out apple. Bite apple. Chew. Swallow. Take out water bottle. Open bottle. Drink water. Close bottle. Put trash in bin. Put lunch bag back in refrigerator.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate. Administer medication. Record vital signs. Consult with doctor. Say 'Patient needs more pain relief.' Walk to supply room. Take out bandages. Walk to patient room. Change bandage. Wash hands. Walk to nurse station. Type notes. Answer phone. Say 'Clinic, how may I help you?' Transfer call. Walk to waiting room. Call next patient.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Release parking brake. Press gas pedal. Drive. Stop at red light. Press gas pedal. Park car in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Walk to front door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plates. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat. Chew. Swallow.

Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Turn on tap. Wet sponge. Add soap. Wash pot. Rinse pot. Place pot on drying rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe table. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ice cream. Take out spoon. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat ice cream. Watch TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading or watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Yawn. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
